newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hallenstein committed to growing mkt shr.
newsitem.headline: Hallenstein committed to growing mkt shr.

text.p: New Zealand retailer Hallenstein Glasson Holdings said on Friday total company sales for the first two months of the 1997 financial year were at a similar level to last year.
It said it was committed to growing its market share and securing new retail sites where appropriate.

"We will continue to make the ongoing investments into new store opportunities in these difficult trading times so that we are well positioned to capitalise on the opportunities when we move out of this current trading cycle," the company said in a statement.
It earlier reported a year net profit of NZ$12.49 million, down from $13.14 million in the corresponding period. A fully imputed dividend of 12 cents per share was announced.

The company said apparel chains found trading difficult in December 1995, and this continued through the whole of the 1996 winter season as the New Zealand domestic economy slowed and interest rates rose.
Trading margins for the year finished at a similar level to last year. On August 1, NZ$15.2 million worth of stock was on hand, compared to $14.1 million the previous year.
Hallenstein will hold its annual meeting on December 3.
